senses.gloss: (b. h.) to touch closely, (b. h. to mince); to join, add. Part. pass. טָפוּף, f. טְפוּפָה (cmp. טְפֵי III) added to, liberally measured, contrad. to מחוק levelled, a. גדוש heaped.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 7a:5">Men. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>לביסא ט׳</he> to a basin brimful, with something added on top.—Pl. <he>טְפוּפוֹת</he>.
